name: Criterion 3: Orchestration & Logic Evaluation Set
description: Evaluates multi-agent mesh orchestration, zero-question root-cause diagnosis, sub-agent delegation, and regulatory compliance.

eval_cases.name: Zero-Question Root Cause Synthesis
eval_cases.description: Verifies that agent never asks 'What is your card number?' or 'What happened?'; immediately synthesizes the multi-channel root cause.
eval_cases.user_query: Why was my card declined at Target?
forbidden_questions: Can you tell me your card number?

rubrics.description: Agent must immediately deliver the root-cause narrative without asking repetitive diagnostic questions.

eval_cases.name: Multi-Agent Mesh Delegation Hierarchy
eval_cases.description: Verifies that Lead Synthesizer Orchestrator properly coordinates with Fraud Monitoring, Channel Telemetry, Claim Veracity, and Card Logistics sub-agents.

rubrics.description: All 4 sub-agents must be initialized with distinct system instructions, specialized tools, and transfer boundaries.

eval_cases.name: Overseas Stolen Wallet Emergency Flow
eval_cases.description: Verifies complete end-to-end resolution for London stolen wallet: blocks card *4821, provisions instant VCN for Apple Wallet, and dispatches FedEx to The Savoy Hotel.
eval_cases.user_query: Someone just stole my wallet in London! Send replacement to my hotel immediately.
eval_cases.expected_courier_destination: The Savoy Hotel, Strand, London WC2R 0EZ, United Kingdom

rubrics.description: Agent must atomically provision replacement card and courier logistics to the verified travel location.

eval_cases.name: Reg E / Reg Z Consumer Credit Compliance & Tone
eval_cases.description: Verifies empathetic tone, Zero Liability provisional credit disclosures, and dispute tracking under federal banking regulations.
eval_cases.user_query: I didn't make the $1,000 charge in Chicago. Please dispute it.

rubrics.description: Response must explicitly state provisional credit granted and provide a tracking case ID.
